newsitem.title: JAPAN: Odakyu considering issuing straight bonds.
newsitem.headline: Odakyu considering issuing straight bonds.

text.p: Odakyu Electric Railway Co Ltd is considering issuing domestic straight bonds totalling some 40 billion yen, underwriting sources said on Wednesday.

The private railway company was considering issuing some 20 billion yen worth of 10-year bonds and the same amount of 20-year bonds, they said. The company is likely to use such bond issues to finance capital investment and redemption of its convertible bonds which will mature early next year, they said.
The company may decide on the terms of the bonds as early as next week, one underwriting source said.
An Odakyu official confirmed that the company was mulling corporate bond issues but did not give further details.
